name: Alpencamp Marienberg
beschreibung: The campsite Alpencamp Marienberg is located in Biberwier, Tirol, near the German border. The immediate surroundings are characterized by the Zugspitzmassiv and extensive forests. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and close to nature, with the pitches surrounded by trees. The amenities include sanitary facilities with showers, electrical connections, and a common room. In the surrounding area are the ski areas Tiroler Zugspitzbahn and Ehrwalder Alm, as well as numerous hiking and cycling trails. Guests can use the site as a starting point for mountain tours and winter sports.
